Zero decision errors; the Metagrossite pick was correct since 178 Jolly Meta outspeed their entire g1 four.

MATCHUP vs Metagross-Mega/Aerodactyl/Incineroar/Rotom-Wash/Mamoswine/Manectric. My team: Gholdengo, Sinistcha, Floette(Mega), Rotom-Heat.

OPPONENT TENDENCIES (durable): Game 1 bring was Metagross-Mega + Aerodactyl + Incineroar + Mamoswine (Rotom-Wash and Manectric benched) — expect the same four. They Mega-evolve Metagross. Incineroar is their engine: Intimidate on entry, Fake Out, and Darkest Lariat 2HKOs almost everything I have (super effective on Sinistcha/Gholdengo). They use Protect proactively on Metagross to blank predicted spread/Matcha Gotcha turns, so they read my support moves. Aerodactyl sets Tailwind, carries Wide Guard + Taunt + Rock Slide and Focus Sash (needs two hits in one turn; Wide Guard blanks my spread moves — avoid Make It Rain into it). Incineroar Sitrus Berry, Mamoswine Life Orb, Aerodactyl Focus Sash.

TEAM-PREVIEW CONCLUSIONS: Floette-Mega is a bad bring into this core — Metagross-Mega resists Fairy, and 132 Speed loses to Metagross/Aerodactyl/Mamoswine; it dies before doing work. Prefer bringing no Mega, or hold Floette strictly as a late cleaner after Metagross-Mega and Aerodactyl are removed. Sinistcha is NOT the Incineroar answer: Lariat (53-77%) + Flare Blitz outrun Strength Sap/Matcha healing. Core bring: Gholdengo + Rotom-Heat.

KEY THREAT RULES: Metagross-Mega Stomping Tantrum OHKOs Rotom and 2HKOs Gholdengo and outspeeds my whole team — kill it the turn it appears (Gholdengo LO Shadow Ball 81-141%, Rotom Charcoal Overheat 101-178%) or Protect.
